# Permission matrix

Every action needs **all** of the scopes listed for it. Scopes are independent: `spend` does not imply `edit`.

## studio

Scopes: `read`, `edit`, `spend`, `publish` · new keys default to `read` + `edit` + `spend`

| Needs | Actions |
|---|---|
| `edit` | 145 |
| `read` | 126 |
| `spend` | 41 |
| `publish` | 14 |
| `edit + spend` | 2 |
| `spend + publish` | 1 |

What a key can do, by scope set:

| Key scopes | Allowed | Denied |
|---|---|---|
| `read` | 126 | 203 |
| `read` + `edit` | 271 | 58 |
| `read` + `edit` + `spend` | 314 | 15 |
| `read` + `edit` + `spend` + `publish` | 329 | 0 |

Some Studio actions also change scope with their arguments: `analyze_refs` with `mode: "style"` is `spend`; blog generation that is not a draft is `spend + publish`; `motion_create` (with a `prompt`) and `motion_direct_reply` are `edit` when no platform text model runs and are refused without `spend` when one does. The server is always the authority.

## team

Scopes: `read`, `edit`, `spend` · new keys default to `read` + `edit`

| Needs | Actions |
|---|---|
| `edit` | 47 |
| `read` | 20 |
| `spend` | 3 |

What a key can do, by scope set:

| Key scopes | Allowed | Denied |
|---|---|---|
| `read` | 20 | 50 |
| `read` + `edit` | 67 | 3 |
| `read` + `edit` + `spend` | 70 | 0 |

Some Team actions need **more** scopes depending on their arguments (the table above shows the base scope). The server re-checks on every call:

- `team.create_agent`, `team.set_tools`, `team.set_caps`, `team.set_type` → `edit + spend` when they grant a high-risk or unrestricted tool.
- `team.set_budget` → `edit + spend` when it removes the cap.
- `team.set_persona` → `edit + spend` when it turns a schedule on.
- `team_blueprint.install_template` → `edit + spend` for community templates.
- `team_evolve.settings` → `edit + spend` when it turns automatic evolution on.

## open

No scopes. Every tool works with any valid key; spending is limited by the key's monthly cap.
